rows.text: Every time you attack, Raffine makes one of your attackers connive once for each attacking creature: draw that many, discard that many, and a +1/+1 counter for each nonland card discarded. So the deck goes wide with token makers that attack, and every swing is card draw that also grows an evasive threat. The discards feed a reanimation package, so a discarded Archon of Cruelty comes straight back.

rows.name: Raffine, Scheming Seer
rows.text: three mana, a 1/4 flier with ward {1}. Whenever you attack, target attacking creature connives X, where X is the number of attacking creatures: draw X, discard X, and put a +1/+1 counter on it for each nonland card discarded.
Raffine triggers when you attack with ANY creatures; she doesn't have to attack herself. Attack with five tokens and one of them draws and discards five.
Target the creature that is hardest to block (a flier, Fallen Shinobi, a Sword carrier), since it keeps the counters.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep three-colour mana, Raffine, and one cheap creature or token maker. Turn three Raffine, turn four attack with two creatures and connive two.
Discard creatures you can reanimate, and lands once the board is set; nonland discards grow the conniver.
When the board is wide, protect the alpha strike with Grand Abolisher or Silence, then Akroma's Will or Moonshaker Cavalry.
